reasons: The inserted 10.3 supplies every atomic element of the preferred position: assistance on expiry or termination, up to six months, at then-current rates, return of Customer Data in a standard machine-readable format within 30 days, and deletion with written certification thereafter.

The deterministic check reporting the 30-day return as absent appears to mis-fire; the operative text expressly states "within 30 days after expiry or termination, return all Customer Data", so the element is met on a literal reading.

The "at Customer's request" condition attaches only to transition assistance, not to the data-return, deletion, or certification duties, so the mandatory post-termination return is not swallowed; "reasonable" is a minor qualifier to be noted in the rationale, not a fallback failure.
Minimality holds: a single concise new subsection was added for an otherwise absent clause, with no rewrite of 10.1, 10.2, or 16.5 and no new exceptions.
Intent preserved: existing survival, refund, and confidentiality mechanics remain effective; "Customer Data" and "Order Form" are defined terms and no dangling cross-reference is created.
